episodes.synopsis: The Republic of San Magnolia fights a safe humane war using drones. In reality, however, the drones are piloted by humans called 86s, who are called “pigs” and considered less than human.
episodes.title: Undertaker

episodes.synopsis: As Lena lives a life of safety and comfort inside the walls of her city, the 86ers fight a terrible battle against an unstoppable and inhuman enemy.
episodes.title: Spearhead

episodes.synopsis: Lena finds herself growing closer to the Spearhead squadron, or so she thinks. But a deadly battle drastically changes her perspective.
episodes.title: I Don't Want to Die

episodes.synopsis: After a brutal death, Lena comes to terms with her real status as an Alba, and what it means to force another to fight for your sake.
episodes.title: Real Name

episodes.synopsis: Lena learns the truth about the upcoming end of the war, and how the Legion is a much more deadly threat than she thought.
episodes.title: I'm With You

episodes.synopsis: Spearhead enjoys a brief respite near the cherry blossoms outside the wall, but a deadly attack brings the dangers of war even closer to home.
episodes.title: Through to the End

episodes.synopsis: As the day of the festival arrives, Lena and Shin watch the fireworks and enjoy a brief respite from their battles.
episodes.title: Will You Remember Me?

episodes.synopsis: Spearhead is given orders to undertake a pointless march into enemy territory, and not to stop until they're dead. Lena tries her best to stop this suicide mission from happening.
episodes.title: Let's Go

episodes.synopsis: Shin confronts his brother deep within Legion held territory. But even if he wins, there's no going back.
episodes.title: Goodbye

episodes.synopsis: The crew of Spearhead has left on their final mission, never to return home. What awaits them outside the borders of their home?
episodes.title: Thank You

episodes.synopsis: Spearhead Squadron comes to the end of their long road, and a new journey begins for Lena...
episodes.title: Here We Go
